title: REQ · BootScene.ts has a single SceneObject type import
summary: Only one `import type { SceneObject }` line remains in BootScene.ts
description: Context: L12 and L14 of BootScene.ts both import SceneObject from '@game/entities/SceneObject'. Desired behavior: the second import (L14) is removed. Expected result: one import line, no duplicate identifier error. Why: a duplicate import is a compile error.
acceptance_criteria: Given BootScene.ts, when the lines matching /^import type \{ SceneObject \}/ are counted, then the count is 1.
Given the removal, when the file is read, then the import of createPhaserRenderContext from './renderContext' is still present.
